title: Paragon Of Time
description:
You stand at the edge of time, trying to save the last crumbs of humanity, fighting dark creatures that are puppeteered by an even darker force. You, the Paragon of Time, are an ancient hero that has now awaken to complete your mission: Vanquish the darkness.

Paragon Of Time is a rogue-lite adventure game where you collect powerful upgrades and forge new weapons to strengthen your character. 

 

As you fight your way through, you’ll destroy enemies to claim mighty artefacts, and use them to enhance your abilities and weapons. This way, you can make unique builds that suit your playstyle, making most playthroughs unique.

After each played round, you will be able to permanently improve your character by purchasing upgrades using the souls of your enemies.

Your ultimate goal is to overcome the final challenge—the all-consuming malice that enshrouds the earth—and bring an end to its corruption.
description_short: Crush the darkness that is corrupting time itself. Wield mighty artifacts, forge legendary weapons, and conquer the horrors that seek to break you, in this roguelite, dark-fantasy adventure.
